title: Full Stack Engineer (Go and React)
description:
Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989. Miratech has coverage across five continents and operates in 25 countries worldwide. Miratech retains over 1000 full-time professionals and has achieved sustained shareholder value growth exceeding 25% annually over many years.

Join a team building innovative, cloud-native applications that power next-generation conversational AI and enterprise solutions. As a Full Stack Engineer, you will develop scalable backend services, APIs, microservices, and modern web applications using Golang and React. You will work with modern cloud technologies, solve complex engineering challenges, and contribute to reliable, high-performance solutions that support evolving business needs.
Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performance backend services, REST APIs, and microservices using Golang.
- Build responsive, reusable, and user-friendly web applications using React, and modern frontend development practices.
- Integrate frontend applications with backend services, third-party APIs, and enterprise systems to enable seamless data exchange and business workflows.
- Develop and enhance cloud-native applications and distributed systems, contributing to reliable, scalable, and efficient application architectures.
- Write clean, maintainable, and testable code; participate in code reviews, automated testing, debugging, and performance optimization.
- Support CI/CD pipelines, application deployments, monitoring, logging, and production troubleshooting to maintain application stability and reliability.
- Identify and resolve technical issues, optimize application performance, and contribute to continuous improvements across the development lifecycle.
- Work closely with product, architecture, security, and engineering teams to deliver end-to-end solutions, using approved AI-assisted development tools where appropriate to improve productivity and code quality.

- 5+ years of professional software development experience.
- 3+ years of hands-on experience developing frontend applications using React.
- 3+ years of experience in Go programming, backend development, REST APIs, and microservices.
- Experience with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or Azure.
- Hands-on experience with distributed systems, API integrations, and application design.
- Experience with relational or NoSQL databases, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
- Understanding of application security, performance optimization, debugging, and production support.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
Nice To Have
- Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native application architectures.
- Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging platforms such as Kafka.
- Exposure to conversational AI, chatbot applications, or AI-powered solutions.
- Familiarity with real-time communication, voice integrations, or telephony technologies.
- Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability tools.
- Exposure to third-party AI/ML integrations or generative AI solutions.

We offer:
- Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth.
- Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, language courses, and a relocation program.
- Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
- Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
- Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
- Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events.
- Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.
* Miratech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law.

title: Sr. Software Engineer
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com http://OpenGov.com.




JOB SUMMARY

At OpenGov bold ideas ship daily and rapid iteration turns directly into measurable customer impact. We stay relentlessly aligned with customer outcomes while pushing the frontier of AI-driven software development, using cutting-edge AI tools and techniques to build systems that scale.

As a Sr. Software Engineer at OpenGov, you will develop top-tier SaaS solutions that enhance efficiency, transparency, and accountability in government agencies. As a crucial member of our engineering team, you’ll lead and deliver new features and improvements in a fast-paced, agile environment, utilizing modern technologies such as ReactJS, Typescript, GraphQL, and NodeJS. Strong communication and collaboration skills are essential for maintaining the highest standards.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Collaborate across the organization to understand and translate business priorities into shipped features delivering customer success.

 - Generate clean, efficient, and well-documented software following industry best practices.

 - Provide leadership and technical guidance to ensure the development of resilient, scalable SaaS applications.

 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand and translate business requirements into technical specifications.

 - Troubleshoot, debug and resolve complex technical issues.

 - Mentor and guide junior software engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

 - Contribute to OpenGov’s Engineering culture of innovation, leading-edge technology adoption and quality

 - Cultivate customer empathy to ensure that the solutions exceed customer expectations.

 - Drive continuous improvement of development processes, tools, and operational excellence.

 - Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends, advocating for their adoption where appropriate.




REQUIREMENTS AND PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

 - Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth, ambiguous environment.

 - Demonstrated experience in working with customers to improve product experiences

 - Experience working across the stack (frontend + backend) and comfort shipping features end-to-end

 - Experience building with AI-driven UX, agents, and workflow automation (direct ML experience not required)

 - BA/BS in a computer science-related field or equivalent experience required.

 - 8+ years of experience in developing highly scalable cloud-native applications.

 - Deep experience building applications on either Azure or AWS using the latest CI/CD  and DevOps best practices

 - Prior experience in building applications that leverage modern tools like Grafana for observability and performance monitoring

 - Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, ReactJS, and NodeJS is a MUST.

 - Proficiency with event-driven architecture, API integration, and GraphQL is a MUST

 - System Design & Backend Architecture – Proven ability to design scalable, reliable, secure distributed backend systems and make sound architectural trade-offs.

 - Strong Software Development – Senior-level, hands-on coding experience delivering production-grade backend services.

 - AI Fluency & AI Agents – Practical experience building with or using AI agents/LLMs, and applying AI to improve engineering workflows.

 - Communication & Influence – Clearly explains technical designs to engineers and leaders; drives org-wide adoption of platform components.

 - Technology Agnostic – Open to working in any tech stack; learns new languages/tools quickly and does not resist change.

 - Cloud Platform – Hands-on experience building shared platform capabilities (cloud infrastructure, IaC, CI/CD, observability, developer tooling) used by multiple teams.




WHY OPENGOV?



A Mission That Matters. 

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust.  Some people say this is boring.  We think it’s the core of our democracy.



Opportunity to Innovate

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.



A Team of Passionate, Driven People

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.



A Place to Make Your Mark

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.



Benefits That Work for You

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

 - Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families

 - Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions

 - Professional development and growth opportunities

 - A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Software Engineer II
description:
PDI helps convenience store retailers and petroleum wholesale marketers worldwide thrive in a digital economy with enterprise management software. Over 1,500 customers operating more than 200,000 locations trust PDI to optimize their operations, whether they are a single site, multi-site, dealer or a franchise operator. PDI’s enterprise software, wholesale and logistics management software solutions and retail back-office systems have been designed around the evolving needs of customers for more than 35 years. We re-imagine enterprise management to help our customers transform their business and deliver exceptional experiences. Backed by the investment of TA Associates, Genstar and Insight Venture Partners, PDI is embarking upon an aggressive expansion strategy through internal investment in development as well as intensive M&A activity. The result will be a broader, more powerful, international company that serves customers across the entire supply chain, from wholesalers to retailers, and every stop in between.


Role Overview:
If you love to design scalable fault-tolerant systems that can run efficiently with high performance and are eager to learn new technologies and develop new skills, then we have a great opportunity for you: join our PDI family and work closely with other talented PDI engineers to deliver solutions that delight our customers every day!
You will play a key role in designing and building our market leading software products as we drive to continuously increase our cloud maturity and mobility. You will be working as a key part of an agile team to design, build, test, and support PDI's enterprise software solutions. You will review, recommend & implement system enhancements that will improve the quality, performance, and maintainability of our products. You will be responsible for contributing to an always improving Engineering environment by ensuring all stakeholders (engineers, architects, product owners, SREs, IT Ops…) are informed of status and supported in their roles.
Job

Job Responsibilities:
- AI-Powered POS, EPS & Forecourt Development: Build intelligent systems across Point of Sale, Electronic Payment Systems, and Forecourt management using C# and .NET, incorporating real-time analytics, payment integration, inventory intelligence, and multi-step automation workflows for retail, hospitality, and fuel environments.

- Product Innovation & AI Integration: Develop next-generation ASP.NET Core platforms with generative AI features including predictive pump management, fraud detection, and forecourt monitoring optimized for performance, UX, and safety compliance.
Intelligent System Architecture: Leverage LLMs and multimodal models within .NET service architectures using SignalR for real-time features and Entity Framework Core for data access, delivering context-aware experiences across POS, EPS, and forecourt domains.

- Payment & Forecourt Integration: Develop and maintain integrations with payment terminals (ISO 8583, EMV, NFC) and forecourt controllers (Gilbarco, Wayne) using IFSF, OPT, and serial/TCP protocols, ensuring end-to-end PCI-DSS, compliance and reliable pump authorization workflows.

- Backend API & Cloud Deployment: Design RESTful and event-driven APIs using ASP.NET Core Web API; deploy and maintain .NET applications on Azure using Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling for high-availability transactional workloads.

- Testing, UI & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Write automated tests (xUnit/ NUnit / MSTest) and contribute to agent evaluation frameworks; build UI components using React as needed; work closely with product, UX, and operations teams to translate workflows into production-ready solutions.

Job Requirements:
- Core Experience: 3–5 years of professional software engineering with demonstrated ownership in production systems; experience in transactional, high-availability, retail, payment, or forecourt environments is a strong plus.

- C# & .NET Stack: Strong proficiency in C#, ASP.NET Core, Web API, Entity Framework Core, LINQ, dependency injection, and NuGet package management.

- Payment & Forecourt Protocols: Familiarity with ISO 8583, EMV, NFC, and PCI-DSS compliance; familiarity with forecourt integration (IFSF, OPT, pump authorization) and serial/TCP communication protocols is recommended.

- Agentic Systems Mastery: Proven hands-on experience building intelligent, automation-driven systems across any platform/product including workflow orchestration for multi-step transactions.

- AI & Backend Integration: Hands-on experience integrating LLMs or AI services into backend systems, including prompt engineering, RAG, and automation workflows
Cloud & DevOps: Experience deploying .NET applications to AWS with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling.

- Web APIs & Real-Time Communication: Experience building scalable APIs with RESTful design, authentication patterns, and SignalR for live event streaming across transactions and forecourt operations.

- Testing & Security: Strong test-driven development practices (xUnit/ NUnit/ MSTest); solid understanding of secure coding, PCI-DSS, and protection against injection/tampering in high-value transactions.

- Additional Skills: Proficiency with Visual Studio/VS Code and Git workflows; familiarity with Python, JavaScript, or Pascal (Delphi); knowledge of vector databases or data pipelines for analytics is a plus.

- Soft Skills: Strong communication and collaboration ability; growth mindset; effective cross-domain teamwork with initiative-taking and good judgment about when to seek guidance.

Behavioral Competencies:
- 
Ensures Accountability

- 
Manages Complexity

- 
Communicates Effectively

- 
Balances Stakeholders

PDI is committed to offering a well-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career.  This includes a competitive salary, market-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work-life balance with ample time off [time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements.  Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Overview
On Team Xbox, we aspire to empower the world's 3 billion gamers to play the games they want, with the people they want, anywhere they want. Gaming is a significant growth opportunity for Microsoft, and we continue to innovate through Cloud Gaming, Game Pass on PC, and the expanded possibilities created by Activision Blizzard King. 

Xbox Commerce builds the developer tools and services that help game creators craft compelling experiences, the commerce systems that connect publishers with their audiences, and the platforms and experiences that help players discover and enjoy their next favorite games. 

The Xbox Commerce team enables publishers to access our ecosystem with low friction, gain rich insights into the publishing experience, and deliver content to gamers around the world. We partner across Xbox and with internal and external game studios while maintaining highly available services and protecting customer data.

Responsibilities
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and operate high-scale, high-availability back-end services that power publisher-facing experiences. You will drive service-based solutions across Xbox Commerce and partner teams, bring strong web services and distributed-systems expertise, and help evolve how we deliver software through AI-enabled engineering and agentic workflows. 
Responsibilities 

Core Engineering and Service Delivery:

- Design, implement, and operate secure, scalable, and highly available back-end services for publisher-facing experiences. 

- Lead technical design and drive implementation of service-based solutions across Xbox Commerce and partner teams. 

- Collaborate with engineering, product, and partner teams across Xbox, as well as internal and external game studios, to deliver comprehensive solutions. 

- Champion product quality, test engineering, observability, operational readiness, and evidence-based problem solving throughout the development lifecycle. 

- Diagnose complex engineering and production issues, improve service reliability, and reduce recurring operational toil. 

AI-Enabled Engineering and Agentic Delivery:

Use AI responsibly to accelerate delivery while preserving engineering rigor, security, and human accountability. 

- Build reusable agents, tools, and workflows that connect well-defined specifications to implementation, testing, code review, and safe delivery across our services. 

- Maintain the engineering context these workflows require, including service documentation, architecture guidance, repository conventions, and runbooks. 

- Apply AI-assisted development and diagnostics to engineering and operational problems. Verify outputs through tests, reviews, and supporting evidence, and choose deterministic automation when it is the better fit. 

- Establish appropriate boundaries for agent autonomy through scoped permissions, sensitive-data protection, auditability, and human oversight of consequential changes. Measure effectiveness through software quality, delivery lead time, review effort, operational toil, and cost.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field and 8+ years of technical engineering experience coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python; or equivalent experience. 

- Hands-on experience applying AI coding assistants, software agents, or reusable developer tooling to development, testing, review, or operational workflows, and evaluating their effectiveness through tests and measurable outcomes. 

- Understanding of security considerations for AI-enabled engineering, including prompt injection, sensitive-data handling, least-privilege tool access, and safe execution of generated code. 

Preferred Qualifications 

- Excellent design, debugging, and problem-solving skills. 

- Demonstrated commitment to customers, product quality, and test engineering. 

- Experience shipping high-quality products or services. 

- Familiarity with Azure, Autopilot, web services, multi-tier client/server distributed applications, and cross-device testing. 

- Knowledge of distributed cloud technologies such as Kubernetes, Redis, Azure Data Lake, and Cosmos DB. 

- Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple teams. 

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

title: Software Engineer (Python, FastAPi, GenAI)
description:
Job Summary 
We are seeking a highly skilled Python & Generative AI Engineer (3–4 years experience) to design, build, and optimize scalable, cloud-native AI applications. This role blends hands-on development, system design, and applied AI engineering, with a focus on Large Language Models (LLMs) and Small Language Models (SLMs). 
The ideal candidate is a strong backend engineer with experience in distributed systems and AI-driven applications, capable of owning features end-to-end while contributing to architecture, performance optimization, and model fine-tuning workflows. 
Role: Python & Generative AI Engineer 
Responsibilities 
- Develop scalable, maintainable, and high-quality backend applications using Python, FastAPI, and cloud-native technologies. 

- Design and build RESTful APIs and microservices with a focus on performance, reliability, security, and maintainability. 

- Develop and integrate Generative AI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and vector databases. 

- Build AI-powered services leveraging Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, LangChain, LangGraph, or similar AI application frameworks. 

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, test, deploy, and support AI-powered applications throughout the software development lifecycle. 

- Implement efficient data retrieval and knowledge grounding solutions using embeddings, semantic search, and vector stores.

- Participate in design discussions, technical reviews, and mentoring of junior engineers.

- 3-5 years of software development experience. 

- 1+ years of hands-on experience building production-grade AI/LLM applications. 

Must-Have Skills 
Python Development 
- Strong proficiency in Python and object-oriented programming. 

- Experience with FastAPI, Flask, or Django. 

- Strong understanding of asynchronous programming and API development. 

- Knowledge of design patterns, clean code principles, and software engineering best practices. 

Generative AI & LLM Engineering 
- Hands-on experience with Generative AI and LLM-based applications. 

- Experience with prompt engineering techniques. 

- Experience designing and implementing RAG applications. 

- Familiarity with vector databases such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or Qdrant. 

- Experience working with embedding models and semantic search. 

AI Frameworks 
- Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar AI orchestration frameworks.

Databases

- Experience with ORM frameworks such as SQLAlchemy. 

- Understanding of transaction management and query optimization. 

Messaging & Distributed Systems 
- Experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, or similar messaging platforms. 

- Understanding of microservices and distributed system fundamentals. 

Testing & Quality 
- Experience with PyTest and automated testing frameworks. 

- Familiarity with code quality tools and static code analysis. 

Cloud & DevOps

Observability

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
description:
Strength in Trust 

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

A Senior SDE at Razorpay is well-grounded - smart, quality-focused, product-thinking, and business-conscious. Not a mere coder. You bring strong technical context and the experience to build software that matters at scale. Engineering at Razorpay creates significant impact across the payments ecosystem. You are expected to influence the culture of the company - bring conviction, challenge the status quo, set the bar, and help the team grow. We are looking for engineers who are current - not just technically strong, but actively working in AI-augmented workflows. At Razorpay, AI is not a feature we are building toward - it is part of how we build today.

What You Will Build

- Scale Razorpay's payment infrastructure to get every Indian to pay online

- Shape REST APIs used by developers worldwide

- Contribute to open source and set standards for mobile payments

- Drive product and design discussions - not just implement them

- Brainstorm and create new directions in Razorpay's quest to make online payments easy and accessible to all

What We Are Looking For

- 3+ years of experience in technology

- Strong product design sense - you think about the user, not just the implementation

- Proficiency in any of: PHP, Python, Django, Golang, Java, or C++

- Ability to understand end-user requirements, formulate use cases, and arrive at effective solutions

- Good understanding of REST APIs and the web in general

- Ability to build a feature from scratch and drive it to completion independently

- Willingness to learn new technology - whatever lets you deliver the best product

These systems will combine large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, tool use, workflow orchestration, code intelligence, cloud APIs, and enterprise-grade safety controls.

title: Software Development Engineer III, PaySec, StoreSec
description:
Come build the future with us! In Payments Security (PaySec), we protect the foundational systems and products that allow Amazon to accept payments for all goods, content, and services that people buy at Amazon and around the world. International Emerging Stores Payments (IESP) brings Amazon's payments products to customers in some of the fastest-growing markets in the world, across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), Asia Pacific (APAC) including India, and South America. These markets run on real-time payment rails such as UPI, on local wallets, cards, bill payments, and lending products, and on regulatory regimes that differ from one country to the next. Every one of those transactions depends on customer trust, and IESP Payments Security exists to earn and keep it.

Payments Security owns full-stack Product Security for Payments across Amazon and its business units. We are part of Amazon's broader Stores Security organization, responsible for protecting Amazon's global information assets. We partner with Payments builder teams to make applications and infrastructure secure-by-design from concept to launch and into continuous operations, and we build the mechanisms, guardrails, and automation that let thousands of engineers do the right thing by default.

As a software engineer on IESP Payments Security, you will build the software that makes security automatic for Amazon's payments businesses in MENA, APAC including India, and South America. Imagine writing the code that stops a vulnerability before it is merged, or an AI agent that scans hundreds of production applications and finds payment data stored where it should not be.

You will work on three kinds of problems. First, controls-as-code: security rules and guardrails that run on every code change, including code written with AI assistance. Second, detection agents: AI-assisted services that find sensitive data, vulnerable patterns, and risky configurations across production. Third, onboarding acquired stacks: tooling that brings newly acquired businesses onto Amazon's standard engineering and security platforms. You will work side by side with security engineers, and your work will show up directly in fewer vulnerabilities and less time builders spend fixing them.

As a senior engineer, you will set the technical direction for the team's systems, lead designs that span multiple components and teams, and mentor other engineers.

Key job responsibilities
 • Lead the architecture and technical direction of the team's security tooling, and make trade-offs between precision, coverage, latency, and builder experience.
 • Design, build, test, deploy, and operate secure, highly available services that handle sensitive payments data.
 • Build controls-as-code and code-creation security rules that catch common vulnerability patterns before code is merged.
 • Build AI-assisted detection agents that find sensitive payment data and vulnerable code patterns across production applications, with high precision.
 • Build tooling that onboards acquired businesses' code, cloud accounts, and pipelines onto Amazon's standard security tooling.
 • Build automated remediation that proposes or writes the fix for a finding, not just flags it, so builders spend minutes instead of days.
 • Meet directly with security engineers and service teams to understand their requirements, and design solutions that make them more productive.
 • Estimate engineering effort, plan implementation, and roll out changes that meet requirements for performance, scalability, and reliability.
 • Work with security engineers to turn threat models and findings into automated mechanisms.
 • Contribute to operational excellence through code reviews, testing, monitoring, and on-call.
 • Lead designs that span multiple teams, including integration with Amazon's central security and developer platforms.
 • Work with stakeholders to gather and document requirements, and take part in strategic planning for the team's roadmap.
 • Grow and coach engineers on the team, and raise the bar in design and code reviews.

A day in the life
You will spend most of your time building: designing services, writing and reviewing code, and shipping. You will pair with security engineers who bring a threat model or a class of findings, and together you will decide what can be automated and how to measure that it works. You will meet the service teams who use our tools, hear where security slows them down, and fix it. The team runs regular architecture reviews and knowledge shares, and you will learn security from people who do it every day.

About the team
IESP Payments Security is a single-threaded Business Security Team for all of International Emerging Stores Payments. We are security engineers, technical program managers, and software engineers working as one team. We own security for regulated payments and lending businesses, for acquired companies joining Amazon, and for new markets as they launch. We believe security scales through mechanisms and automation, not headcount. As AI writes more of the code our builders ship, we move security into the moment code is created and replace episodic reviews with continuous assurance. We invest in each other's growth as much as we invest in protecting our customers.

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

- 8+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience developing and delivering security software tools
- Expertise in security and permission management systems, such as AWS IAM and AWS Organizations.
- Experience building with large language models or AI agents in production.
- Proven programming ability in Java, C++, Python, Go, TypeScript, or related.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Sr. Software Engineer – Asset Management
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.​

OVERVIEW
The Sitecore Content Hub Developer will be part of a product team responsible for designing, developing, configuring, integrating, and supporting enterprise digital asset and content management capabilities on Sitecore Content Hub.The role will work closely with product owners, business analysts, solution architects, platform engineers, and other technology teams to translate business requirements into scalable Sitecore Content Hub solutions. The individual will provide technical leadership to developers, guide implementation decisions, participate in design and code reviews, and support the platform through delivery and production operations. The role requires strong experience with Sitecore Content Hub, digital asset management concepts, content models, workflows, metadata, integrations, and software engineering practices. The person will also contribute to platform modernization, automation, performance improvements, and continuous improvement initiatives.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Project Participation 
- Participate in the complete software development lifecycle, from requirements and solution design through deployment and support. 
- Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into Sitecore Content Hub solutions. 
- Configure and develop Content Hub entities, schemas, taxonomies, metadata models, policies, workflows, actions, and user roles. 
- Design and implement integrations between Sitecore Content Hub and enterprise systems using REST APIs, webhooks, middleware, and event-driven patterns.
- Develop and maintain custom extensions, scripts, automations, and platform configurations where appropriate.
- Contribute to technical design documents, architecture discussions, sprint planning, and task-level estimation.
- Perform technical design reviews and ensure solutions align with enterprise standards and security requirements.
- Conduct code reviews and ensure maintainable, reusable, and standards-compliant code.
- Lead or contribute to deployment, release, environment promotion, and configuration management activities.
- Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable fixes.
- Monitor and improve application and integration performance, reliability, and scalability.
- Collaborate with other teams to identify dependencies, manage risks, and resolve technical issues.
- Manage multiple workstreams while maintaining quality and delivery commitments.
- Provide application support on a rotation basis, including on-call support where required. 
Learning and Development
- Stay current with Sitecore Content Hub capabilities, product releases, DAM practices, integration patterns, and relevant industry trends.
- Mentor and coach team members to build technical depth and platform expertise.
- Drive process improvements at the project and team level.
- Lead knowledge-sharing sessions, reading groups, demonstrations, and technical communities of practice.
- Participate in hiring, onboarding, and capability development activities.
- Continue to strengthen communication, collaboration, consulting, and leadership skills.
Consulting
- Provide module and project effort estimates.
- Recommend technical solutions and explain trade-offs to stakeholders.
- Act as a Sitecore Content Hub technical subject-matter expert.
- Develop functional expertise in digital asset management, content operations, product information, or a related business domain.
- Serve as a liaison between business analysts, product owners, architects, and developers.
- Answer implementation questions and provide technical direction throughout delivery.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
- Full-Time Bachelor's degree with minimum 10-15 years of total work experience.
- Demonstrated ability to build a work plan or contribute to a work plan appropriate to the role.
- Experience implementing small projects or contributing to medium- or large-scale enterprise technology projects.
- Hands-on experience with Sitecore Content Hub, preferably including Content Management, Digital Asset Management, Product Content Management, or related modules. 
- Experience configuring Content Hub data models, schemas, taxonomies, relations, metadata, workflows, roles, permissions, and business rules.
- Experience with Sitecore Content Hub APIs, REST services, webhooks, integrations, and authentication mechanisms.
- Experience developing or configuring integrations with enterprise applications, cloud services, middleware, or data platforms.
- Strong understanding of DAM concepts, including asset lifecycle management, renditions, versioning, metadata governance, rights management, and content distribution.
- Proficiency in object-oriented programming and at least one modern programming language such as C#, JavaScript, or TypeScript. 
- Working knowledge of .NET, ASP.NET Core, Web API, SQL, JSON, XML, and HTTP-based services. 
- Experience with source control, CI/CD, automated testing, deployment practices, and Agile delivery. 
- Good working knowledge of the enterprise application and technical tools landscape.
- Ability to proactively resolve issues, take ownership, and work across multiple tasks and teams. 
- Ability to become a go-to resource for the team or business group. 
- Experience with third-party integrations and enterprise system interfaces.
- Provide senior-level technical leadership by shaping designs, reviewing code, strengthening engineering standards, collaborating across product and technology teams, and advising business partners.
- Design, develop, and support scalable Sitecore Content Hub capabilities for the reliable management and organization of digital assets and product content.
- Configure and extend Content Hub data models, schemas, taxonomies, relationships, metadata, workflows, roles, permissions, and business rules to support effective content governance.
- Design and maintain integrations between Content Hub and enterprise applications, cloud services, middleware, data platforms, and third-party systems, using Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, messaging/event-driven services, or equivalent technologies.
- Develop solutions using object-oriented programming and modern practices with technologies such as C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Web API, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL, JSON, and XML.
- Apply DAM expertise across the asset lifecycle, including renditions, versioning, rights management, content quality, and distribution.
- Build secure, maintainable services using Content Hub APIs, REST, webhooks, authentication mechanisms, and other HTTP-based interfaces.
- Establish and execute quality-engineering practices, including unit, integration, automated, performance, and regression testing, supported by effective CI/CD and deployment processes.
- Deliver initiatives across the full software-development lifecycle, contribute to medium- and large-scale enterprise projects, and resolve production issues through root-cause analysis and durable fixes.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Sitecore Content Hub certification or formal Sitecore training.
- Experience with Sitecore XM Cloud, Sitecore Experience Platform, or other Sitecore products.
- Experience with Sitecore Content Hub One, Content Operations, or DAM platform migration. 
- Experience with product information management, product data, or master data concepts.
- Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure or GCP.
- Experience with Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, messaging platforms, or equivalent integration services.
- Experience with DevOps tooling, infrastructure automation, observability, and application monitoring.
- Familiarity with accessibility, security, privacy, and enterprise content governance standards.
- Experience with performance testing, unit testing, automated integration testing, and quality engineering.
- Experience working with global, distributed, and cross-functional teams.

ELIGIBILITY
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full-Stack Engineer (React/Node/TypeScript) — First Engineering Hire, Australian EdTech

Remote — Coimbatore preferred; Tamil Nadu / India considered · Full-time · Works directly with the founder in Australia

Meeting our criteria: If you don't think you meet the criteria specified below that is okay. Send through your application. We consider all applicants and we'll be back in touch if we think you might be suitable.

About the role
Merit LMS is a live learning platform used by school children, their tutors and administrators in Australia. We're growing from hundreds of students to thousands, and the platform has to be rock-solid before we do. Making it so is this job. It's a TypeScript product: React + Vite on the front end, Express + Prisma + PostgreSQL on the back end, running on AWS, with Stripe billing and AI-assisted marking. 

We build with Claude Code, an agentic AI coding tool, and that's how we'll keep building. You're not being hired to out-type an AI. You're being hired to take over the technical running of the platform from the founder: decide how things get built, direct the AI agents that build them, and be the last line of defence before anything reaches a child's screen.

You'd be the only engineer. The founder is non-technical and is handing the platform over to you, but stays closely involved in the product and makes the business calls.

How decisions work here (please read this part)
- The founder makes all business decisions: pricing, what we sell, what we promise families, and what ships when.
- You own the technical and design approach. On work that's been handed to you, you pick the best way to do it. You don't need permission for every choice.
- Good ideas are welcome and expected, but you run them past the founder before building. Nothing significant gets built off your own bat.
- Your authority grows over about six months. You start with minor features and improvements. As trust builds, more of the day-to-day design and prioritisation calls become yours. The founder never fully checks out of the product.
If you want total autonomy from day one, or you'd rather be handed fully-specified tickets forever, this isn't the job. It sits in between, and it moves. Initially, you may be handed fully specified tickets, then gradually you will be given autonomy.

What you'll do, day to day
- Direct AI coding agents through real work: Get AI to write plans, split it into small phases, run the build, and review AI's work.
- Review AI-generated changes sceptically. Most of your value is catching the change that looks right, passes the checks, and is wrong. This is the core skill of the job, not a side task. You are allowed to use AI for all parts of planning, development and testing, but you need to ensure that the AI is guided correctly and it doesn't go off course and ultimately take ownership of the AI's outputs.
- Prove changes work. Trace the code paths yourself and drive the app in a browser before anything ships.
- Own releases end to end: feature switches, database migrations against live data, backups before risky steps, the gated deploy, and the checks after it.
- Write it all down: handover notes, decision records, and the registers of planned improvements and feature switches. This product's continuity lives in its documents, and you'd be their custodian.
- Work a standard 9:00 am to 5:00 pm IST day, so you overlap with Australian afternoons and can talk to the founder live. Close each day with a short written handover (just a Teams message will do).

What you own
- Security and children's privacy. Role boundaries between student, tutor and admin; login and session security; making sure no child sees another child's data and no AI output reaches a child unchecked. Anything touching logins, permissions or children's data gets careful human review here, and that review is yours.
- Getting ready to scale. Taking the platform from hundreds of students to thousands: automated tests, monitoring and alerts, performance under load, and infrastructure that grows without breaking.
- Reliability. If the site is down or a child can't finish a lesson, it's yours.
- The release pipeline: GitHub Actions, AWS, process management and environment config.
- Billing correctness. Stripe subscriptions, trials and cancellations. Mistakes here cost families money.
- Code quality over time. Left unchecked, AI agents duplicate code and hide errors. Pushing back on that is the job. Sometimes this can be as simple as managing the context memory of each session, i.e., not letting coding sessions run too long and stopping within, say, 60% to 70% of the context memory used, so the AI doesn't start hallucinating and then get solid handovers to continue in a new session.

About you (ideally, but all applicants considered)
- 5+ years building and shipping production web applications, strong in TypeScript, React and Node.
- Real experience running database migrations on a live production database with real customer data.
- You've owned a production system alone or nearly alone, and have the instincts that come with it.
- Fluent, sceptical use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex or similar). Show us something you directed an agent to build, and tell us about a time you caught it producing something subtly broken.
- Excellent code review. You can read an unfamiliar 500-line change and find the one line that's wrong. Or be good at using AI to do this.
- Clear, plain-English communication with a non-technical person. You explain risk honestly, including when the honest answer is "I'm not sure".
- Disciplined written handover. You leave a trail someone else could pick up.
- Reliable daily overlap with Australian hours, and a stable home working setup. A standard 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. workday in Indian time IST fits well with us, as tutoring runs till 8 p.m. in our local time (Australian Eastern time).

Nice to have
- Cybersecurity experience, which would be a real advantage. For example: application security and secure code review, penetration testing, hardening logins and sessions, AWS security, threat modelling, or handling a security incident. Certifications (such as OSCP, CompTIA Security+ or AWS Certified Security – Specialty) are welcome but not required.
- Scaling a web app through rapid growth: performance tuning, load testing, PostgreSQL under pressure.
- Adding automated tests to an existing codebase (for example Playwright or Vitest).
- Prisma, PostgreSQL, Express, Tailwind/shadcn, Vite · AWS operations · GitHub Actions · Stripe subscription billing.
- Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) and designing for children.
- Previous experience working with sensitive personal data that the law protects (such as children's, health or financial records).
- AI in production: prompt design, provider fallback, cost control.

What this job is not
We'd rather you rule yourself out now than three months in.
- There is no team. No one reviews your work but you and the agents you point at it.
- Automated testing is still being built. Building that safety net is part of your job.
- It's hardening, not greenfield. You'll be making a working, live product stronger and working down a list of known improvements. You won't be starting fresh.
- The codebase carries a lot of process: safety rules, phased work, registers and handovers. It exists because the product serves children and one bad release has real consequences. You need to find that sensible rather than annoying.

First six months
- Month 1: learn it. Learn the system, the safety rules and the release process. Ship something small and low-risk, end to end. Start fixing bugs & issues. Getting started on product improvements.
- Months 2–3: build the safety net. Automated tests on the paths that matter most (logging in, lessons, billing), better monitoring and alerts, and a security review of logins, permissions and children's data.
- Months 3–4: take the lead. Work through the list of planned improvements, and lead a feature from plan to release.
- Months 4–6: get ready for scaling. Find and fix what would break with ten times the students (performance, database load, infrastructure), and take on more of the design and prioritisation calls, with the founder's sign-off.

How we'll assess you
Three steps, no more.
- A structured interview about a production system you owned, an incident you handled, and how you use AI coding tools critically.
- A short, paid code-review exercise. We give you an AI-generated change like the ones you'd review here. You tell us what you'd approve, what you'd send back, and what you'd check before it went near a child. This is the actual job.
- A conversation with the founder about risk, communication, and how you'd say no.

The package
- Salary: ₹10–14 lakh per year, depending on experience.
- Bonus: a performance-based bonus may be paid, at management's discretion.
- Employment: full-time employee in India, employed through an Employer of Record (a company that handles Indian payroll and employment on our behalf).
- Leave and benefits: standard Indian employment terms, provided through the Employer of Record.
- Equipment: we provide a work laptop.
- Tools: we provide your AI coding tools, including Claude Code.
- Location: remote. Coimbatore preferred; Tamil Nadu and the rest of India considered.
- Hours: a standard 9:00 am to 5:00 pm IST working day, for live overlap with Australian afternoons.
- Start: we understand notice periods and will wait for the right person. If you're available for an immediate start, that's a great plus.
- Conditions: offers are subject to background verification and a declaration that you won't hold a second job alongside this one.
- No fees: we will never ask you to pay anything at any stage of hiring.

How to apply
Send your CV (required). A cover letter is optional, but please answer these three questions — a few sentences each is plenty:
- A production system you owned.
- One thing an AI coding agent got wrong that you caught.
- How you'd approach a database migration you can't undo.
If you have security experience, tell us about that too.

- Experience with observability, logging, and monitoring stacks (e.g., structured logging, metrics, alerting).
- Experience working in Agile development environments and contributing to UI/UX improvements.
 
What We're Looking For

Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Team:

The Social Planner team is a dedicated product group within HighLevel’s Leadgen organization, focused on delivering a seamless social media management experience. We empower agencies and businesses to create, schedule, and manage posts across multiple platforms, while also providing automation, analytics, and engagement tools.

Our primary objectives are to drive Social Planner adoption, improve feature retention, and maximize user engagement by making social publishing effortless and impactful.

We are responsible for:

Post Publishing & Scheduling We enable agencies to publish and schedule posts across major social platforms, ensuring timely and consistent content delivery.

Post Automation We support advanced publishing workflows, including CSV uploads, RSS-to-post, Review Posts, Category Queues, and Recurring Queues—giving agencies full flexibility to manage content at scale.

Engagement & Insights Through Social Statistics, Comment Management, and Social Listening, we provide agencies with deep insights into performance and engagement, enabling data-driven content strategies.

Best Time to Post We surface AI-driven recommendations on when to post for maximum reach and engagement, helping agencies optimize their content strategy.

Multi-Platform Integration We currently support integrations with 9 major platforms—Google Business Profile, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Threads, and Bluesky—along with HighLevel’s internal Community product.

About the Role:

Millions of businesses post to social media through HighLevel's Social Planner. Hundreds of thousands of posts go out every day across every major social platform, each with its own API, rate limits and frequent changes. Our job is to make that look easy.

We're a small team with a big surface area, and we're building the next layer on top of publishing: understanding what the internet is saying about our customers, at scale, with AI. We're hiring a senior full stack engineer who wants to own that.

Responsibilities

- Own features end to end, from PRD to production to "did it work?".
- Design and operate reliable distributed systems: message queues, background workers, schedulers and integrations with third-party platform APIs.
- Build data pipelines that gather millions of social data and metrics from many sources, enrich them, and built infrastructure for fast analytics.
- Process media at scale: images and video uploaded, transformed, generated and delivered to every social platform in the format each one expects.
- Ship both the backend APIs and the frontend UI. Care about how it feels, not just that it works.
- Integrate AI into the product where it makes things better.
- Notice things nobody asked you to fix, and fix them.

Requirements

- 4+ years building and operating production distributed systems.
- Experience with large-scale data engineering: ingestion, ETL/ELT, data warehousing (ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake or similar), and analytics over billions of rows. Social listening, NLP or sentiment analysis is a big plus.

About Us

We believe the future of software development is AI-native — where engineers operate at a higher level of abstraction and quality remains non-negotiable. 
Incubyte is a software craft consultancy where the “how” of building software matters as much as the “what”. 
We partner with companies of all sizes, from helping enterprises build, scale, and modernize to early-stage founders bring their ideas to life. 
Our engineers operate in an AI-native development model, using AI as a collaborator across the SDLC to accelerate development while upholding the discipline of software craftsmanship. Guided by Software Craftsmanship and Extreme Programming practices, we build reliable, maintainable, and scalable systems with speed, without compromising quality. If this way of building software resonates with you, we’d like to talk. 

Our Guiding Principles 
These principles define how we work at Incubyte. They are non-negotiable. 
Relentless Pursuit of Quality with Pragmatism 
 We build high-quality systems without losing sight of delivery. 
Extreme Ownership 
 We take responsibility end-to-end for decisions, execution, and outcomes. 
Proactive Collaboration 
 We collaborate closely, challenge each other, and solve problems together. 
Active Pursuit of Mastery 
 We continuously improve our craft and raise our bar. 
Invite, Give, and Act on Feedback 
We seek, give, and act on feedback to get better every day. 
Ensuring Client Success 
We act as trusted partners and focus on real outcomes, not just output. 

Job Description
This is a remote position.

Experience Level 

The Staff Software Craftsperson is a technical leadership role equivalent to an SDE-4/SDE-5. We are looking for seasoned engineers with 8+ years of hands-on experience who have transitioned from building great software to shaping the engineering culture and technical strategy of an entire organization. 
As a Staff-level crafter, your focus shifts from solving well-defined problems to identifying and solving the most complex, ambiguous technical challenges that impact our clients and our internal engineering standards. 

What You’ll Do as a Software Craftsperson 

- Technical Vision & Architecture: Lead the architectural direction for complex, large-scale systems. You will balance the immediate needs of the business with long-term system health, ensuring our solutions remain simple, scalable, and resilient. 
- Engineering Excellence at Scale: Champion disciplined engineering practices (TDD, Pair Programming, CI/CD) across multiple teams. You don’t just follow the bar; you raise it by introducing better patterns and tooling. 
- AI Strategy & Mentorship: Drive our AI-native development model. You will experiment with and define how we use AI to accelerate the SDLC, ensuring the team uses these tools to enhance—rather than replace—deep technical judgment. 
- Cross-Team Leadership: Act as a force multiplier. You will mentor senior engineers, conduct high-impact code reviews, and foster a culture of continuous learning and craftsmanship. 
- Strategic Client Partnership: Work as a technical consultant for high-stakes client engagements, translating vague business goals into robust technical roadmaps and navigating complex stakeholder environments. 
- Systemic Problem Solving: Beyond resolving production issues, you identify "class-level" problems in our infrastructure or codebase and implement systemic changes to eliminate them permanently. 

Requirements

What We're looking for 
- 8+ years of experience building and maintaining high-scale production systems. 
- Mastery of Fundamentals: Expert-level understanding of object-oriented design, functional programming, and system architecture (Microservices, Event-driven, etc.). 
- Polyglot Mindset: High proficiency in Ruby on Rails and React/Angular, with the proven ability to architect solutions across multiple tech stacks (Python, Go, etc.) as needed. 
- Influence without Authority: Demonstrated ability to lead through persuasion and technical excellence rather than just hierarchy. 
- Advanced AI Collaboration: Deep experience integrating AI into a professional workflow to explore architecture, automate toil, and peer-review logic. 
- Proven Ownership: A track record of taking a project from a nebulous idea to a successful, maintained production system. 
- Communication: Exceptional ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and executive leadership. 
- Clear thinking and strong problem-solving ability, with the capacity to break down complex problems into simple, well-structured solutions.
- A strong sense of ownership — you take responsibility for outcomes, care deeply about quality, and are not comfortable shipping work that does not meet your standards 

Benefits

Life at Incubyte 

We are a remote-first company with structured flexibility. Teams commit to shared rhythms during core hours, ensuring smooth collaboration while maintaining autonomy. Twice a year, we come together in person for a co-working sprint and once a year for a retreat - with all travel expenses covered. 

Our environment is built for crafters: pairing, refactoring, experimenting with AI, and pushing the boundaries of software excellence. We are all lifelong learners, and our work is our passion. 

Perks 

- Dedicated learning & development budget. 
- Sponsorship for conference talks. 
- Comprehensive medical & term insurance. 
- Employee-friendly leave policies. 
- Home Office fund 
- Medical Insurance

What you will work on:
The problems span AI, data infrastructure, distributed systems, fintech and compliance software. You might:

- Work with customers to turn complex hiring and payroll workflows into software
- Debug problems across the stack when production behaves differently than expected
- Review designs and code, mentor engineers and raise the technical bar

The lines between product engineering, infrastructure, AI and data engineering are not fixed. You should be comfortable working across all of them.

What we are looking for:
You probably have 5+ years of software engineering experience. We care more about what you have built and owned than the number of years.

You have experience with several of the following:
- Building and owning production systems end to end
- Python and/or TypeScript
- Backend systems and APIs
- PostgreSQL and data-intensive applications
- Distributed systems, data pipelines, or financial and transactional systems
- React, Next.js or modern frontend development
- AWS or similar cloud infrastructure
- LLMs, agents, retrieval, tool use or AI infrastructure
- Making architectural decisions with incomplete information
- Debugging complex systems, including ones you did not build

Experience with payroll, HR tech, fintech, Indian statutory compliance or other regulated industries is a plus, but not required. We would rather hire an exceptional engineer who learns the domain quickly than someone who checks every box.

- Take ownership and drive ambiguous problems all the way to production
- Ship useful software while keeping engineering quality high
- Go deep and keep pulling the thread until you understand what is happening
- Know when a problem needs a sophisticated system and when simple code is the right answer
- Seek feedback and change your mind when the evidence changes

title: Lead Engineer
description:
About Bonterra

Bonterra builds software for nonprofits, public agencies, and social good organizations. Our products help these organizations manage programs and measure the outcomes of their work in their communities.

Our engineering teams build and run cloud-based SaaS applications. We work closely with Product Management, QA, DevOps, Customer Success, and Support to ship software our customers rely on every day.

Role Summary

As a Lead / Staff Engineer, you are a hands-on contributor who takes on our hardest technical problems. You write production code, verify your work, and answer for what happens after release. You spend most of your time building, not reviewing or advising.

You own the technical outcome of efforts across multiple teams, including when they go wrong. You decide which problems are worth solving and break large problems into parts others own.
You use AI across spec, code, and tests, and you hold yourself and your team to a high verification standard. Your influence comes from the work you deliver, not from your title.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver hard technical work yourself
- Personally build the hardest parts of the system, from design through production code.
- Write, test, and ship production code every week.
- Take the hardest failures, such as outages hard to reproduce and data problems, and fix the root cause in code.
- Build prototypes to settle design debates, then build the production version.
- Review the highest-risk changes in addition to your own delivery.

Verify your work and own production results
- Define how each change is verified before release. Write the tests and checks.
- Run the rollout, watch production metrics, and respond when something fails.
- Fix the problems you find after release and write down what you learned.
- Keep reliability and release quality high in the areas you build.

Own technical outcomes across teams
- Own the technical outcome of multi-team efforts, from a vague ask to a measured result.
- Set the migration or rollout plan, run the response when a cutover fails, and sign off on completion.
- Partner with engineering and product leaders on technical sequencing.

Use AI and set the bar for verification
- Use AI across spec, code, and tests in your own daily work. Explain every line you ship and how you verified the result.
- Require evaluation suites for high-risk AI-generated work, such as migrations.
- Train the team in the standards you set.

Decide well on hard problems
- Make design decisions on problems across systems or teams, with competing objectives and high cost if wrong.
- Weigh risk, cost, and roadmap tradeoffs. Choose a phased path when the path lowers risk.
- Choose the simplest design to meet the need. Write down the decision and the reasons.
- Design APIs, schemas, and contracts for durability and correctness, and build them.

Frame problems and simplify
- Decide which problems are worth solving and which are not.
- Cut or cancel work when a smaller change meets the goal.
- Name what you chose not to build.

Align teams and grow engineers
- Align teams with competing goals on one direction, using evidence and working code.
- Mentor engineers and leads. Take part in interviews and candidate evaluation.

What Success Looks Like
- You personally deliver code for the hardest problems in your area, and the code holds up in production.
- Every major change you ship has a stated verification plan and a known production result.
- Production incidents in your area lead to fixes in code and in process.
- Multi-team efforts you lead reach their measured outcomes.
- Your team ships AI-assisted work safely, under verification standards you set.
- Teams agree on one direction because of the working evidence you provide.
- Projects are smaller and clearer because of your framing.

Requirements

Three requirements are mandatory minimums for this role: technical execution, end-to-end ownership, and AI accountability. We screen for these first.
- Hands-on code you personally delivered for a hard problem, how you verified the work, and what happened in production.
- Recent professional experience writing production code as your primary work, not only prototypes or reviews.
- Evidence of accountability for the technical outcome of a multi-team effort, including a failure and how you responded.
- A repeatable AI workflow with verification built in, and the standards you set for others.
- At least one multi-team outcome, with named teams, decisions, and results.
- Examples of design decisions on poorly defined problems, with competing objectives and high cost if wrong.
- Examples of cutting scope or deciding not to build, with the evidence you used.
- Examples of aligning teams with competing goals, with named people and how the disagreement was resolved.
- Production experience with distributed systems, APIs, and cloud infrastructure such as AWS.
- Experience designing API and data contracts for durability and correctness.
- Experience mentoring engineers and leads, and taking part in hiring.
- Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical leaders.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building or operating AI agents in engineering workflows.
- Experience building and evaluating LLM-based systems, including testing for non-deterministic output.
- Experience with API schema governance or platform-wide contract management.
- Experience with event-driven or serverless architectures.
- Experience with security and compliance requirements in a SaaS context.
- Interest in building technology for nonprofits and social impact.

title: Back End Engineer
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Backend Engineer**

**Bangalore, India**

  

**About the Role**

We are hiring a Backend Engineer to build and operate the services that power a leading technology marketplace being relaunched under new ownership.

You will work behind the GraphQL federation, inside the ~40 microservices that own billing, subscriptions, the catalog, RBAC, the proxy's control plane, and the Analytics/Quota services. The runtime is Node.js/TypeScript on AWS EKS, with Aurora MySQL / Postgres and DynamoDB for state, Redis / Elasticache / Couchbase for caching, Kafka (MSK) and Kinesis as the event backbone, and ClickHouse for real-time analytics reads. Every consumer-to-provider call passes through the proxy your services configure, and every dollar of marketplace revenue flows through the commerce code your services own.

  

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Build and operate services Design, ship, and run Node.js/TypeScript services that sit behind the GraphQL federation. Own a slice of the ~40-service estate end-to-end: API design, schema, persistence, tests, deployment, on-call.
* GraphQL federation subgraphs — Add types, resolvers, and capabilities to the federated Platform API. Keep subgraph boundaries clean; respect RBAC at the federation enforcement layer.
* Commerce backbone — Build the subscription, invoicing, overage, dispute, and payout flows that integrate with Stripe and PayPal webhooks and the billing state machine. Make sure metering, billing, and payouts stay accurate, auditable, and replayable.
* Proxy control plane — Build the management APIs and background workers that configure the runtime proxy: API keys, plans, rate-limit policies, quota caches, abuse signals.
* Event-driven systems — Produce and consume Kafka and Kinesis events safely: schema evolution, idempotency, retries, dead-letter handling. Operate Lambda consumers where they're the right tool.
* Data services — Help own the Node.js Analytics Service and Quota Service that front ClickHouse and Snowflake. Keep latency low, queries cheap, and authorisation correct.
* Performance and reliability — Diagnose hot paths, tune queries, add caches where they matter, and remove caches that have become liabilities. Write the SLOs and the alerts that defend them.
* Security isolation — Implement OAuth2 / JWT / mTLS where they belong; respect least-privilege; design APIs that fail closed.
* On-call and incident response — Take part in the rotation. Lead investigations across services when something rooted in your area breaks.
* LLM-assisted engineering — Use LLM-based coding and agentic tooling to evolve how features are designed, reviewed, and tested.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Services you own meet their SLOs, deploy multiple times a day, and rarely wake anyone up.
* Billing, subscription, overage, and payout flows you ship are accurate to the cent, replayable, and trusted by both providers and consumers.
* GraphQL subgraphs you maintain stay fast, well-typed, and pleasant to extend.
* Event pipelines you produce and consume are idempotent, observable, and survive replay and back-pressure.
* The first generation of agent-native primitives you help build land in production and start carrying real agent traffic.

**What You Bring**

* 5–8 years of backend engineering experience, with non-trivial work on production services that real customers depended on.
* Strong TypeScript / Node.js in a production service environment; comfort with async patterns, streams, and back-pressure.
* Solid API design — REST and GraphQL (ideally federation: Apollo Federation, Mercurius, or similar). Schema design, persisted queries, performance tuning.
* Production fluency with SQL — MySQL and/or Postgres. Bonus for Redis or ClickHouse.
* Experience with event-driven systems — Kafka or similar. You understand idempotency, exactly-once myths, and consumer lag.
* Hands-on AWS (EKS, MSK, Kinesis, DynamoDB, Lambda, DMS) and Kubernetes. Comfortable reading and writing Terraform.
* Modern engineering practice: observability, feature flags, CI/CD, and safe rollouts.
* Care for correctness on the money path — you have shipped billing, metering, or payment code before and have the scars to show for it.
* Bonus: experience with API gateways, rate limiting, quota enforcement, usage metering, agent protocols (MCP, A2A, x402), or LLM-based developer tooling.
* You write small, reviewable PRs. You add the test before you fix the bug. You would rather ship a smaller thing well than a bigger thing badly.

description:
**Job Summary**    

**Full Stack AI Engineer**

**The Vision:**  To be the most trusted AI-native product engineering partner for innovative software companies worldwide delivering ownership, speed and measurable outcomes.
