We are looking for a true builder who can operate independently across the entire stack-from crafting responsive user interfaces in React and architecting scalable Node.js backend services to engineering sophisticated AI orchestration, agentic workflows, and RAG pipelines. This is a high-ownership, hands-on engineering role where you will directly translate product requirements into fast, reliable, and cost-efficient intelligent software.

  
   
  **Key Responsibilities**    

* End-to-End Application Development: Independently architect, build, and deploy full-stack AI applications from the React.js frontend and Node.js backend through to the AI orchestration layer.
* API Backend Engineering: Build clean, secure, high-throughput REST/streaming APIs (SSE/WebSockets) in Node.js to support real-time AI interactions, authentication, and third-party integrations.
* Production Full-Stack RAMPS Excellence: Strong command of Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, Performance, and Security (RAMPS)-implementing multi-layer caching (Redis, semantic/client caching), async job queues, query optimization, OAuth 2.0/JWT/RBAC security, and full-stack observability (OpenTelemetry, Grafana) for low-latency, fault-tolerant applications.
* Frontend Experience: Develop intuitive, low-latency user experiences in React.js tailored for AI workflows (streaming responses, citations, human-in-the-loop feedback, and interactive UI states).
* AI Orchestration Agentic Workflows: Design and implement multi-step LLM pipelines, tool-calling workflows, and stateful agents using LangChain and LangGraph.
* RAG Architecture Retrieval Engineering: Build and optimize end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines-implementing chunking strategies, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, and vector database integrations.
* LLM Engineering Optimization: Drive prompt engineering, context window management, token optimization, caching, and model routing strategies to maximize response accuracy while minimizing latency and LLM inference costs.
* AI Observability Evaluation: Implement tracing, logging, and automated evaluation frameworks using tools like LangSmith or LangFuse to monitor quality, catch regressions, and ensure reliable production behavior.
* Engineering Excellence Ownership: Participate in architecture reviews, write maintainable and well-tested code, establish CI/CD pipelines, and collaborate directly with product and client stakeholders to deliver measurable business outcomes.

  
   
  **Requirements**    

* Education Experience: BE/B.Tech/MS in Computer Science or a related field with 6+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including 2+ years building and shipping production GenAI/LLM applications.
* Frontend Engineering (React Next.js): Strong proficiency in React.js, Next.js, and TypeScript, modern state management (Redux, Zustand, TanStack Query/React Query), streaming UI patterns (SSE/WebSockets), and frontend performance optimization for responsive, real-time AI interfaces.
* Backend Distributed Systems (Node.js): Strong proficiency in Node.js (Express, NestJS, Fastify), REST/WebSocket APIs, asynchronous processing, background job queues, and event-driven messaging (BullMQ, RabbitMQ, Kafka), with a solid grasp of retries, circuit breakers, idempotency, and fault-tolerant design.
* Production Full-Stack RAMPS Excellence: Strong command of Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, Performance, and Security (RAMPS)-implementing multi-layer caching (Redis, semantic/client caching), query optimization, OAuth 2.0/JWT/RBAC authentication, and full-stack observability (OpenTelemetry, Grafana) for low-latency, resilient applications.
* Agentic AI LLM Orchestration: Hands-on production experience building multi-step AI applications, tool-calling workflows, and stateful agents using LangChain and LangGraph, alongside prompt engineering, token optimization, and LLM cost/latency optimization.
* Document Ingestion Advanced RAG Pipelines: End-to-end experience processing unstructured formats (PDF, DOCX, Excel) using OCR/parsing tools (Unstructured, Docling, Apache Tika, Azure Document Intelligence, AWS Textract), vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector, Chroma), and advanced retrieval strategies (hybrid search, metadata filtering, query rewriting, reranking, contextual retrieval, parent-child chunking).
* AI Evaluation, Observability Security: Proven experience tracing, debugging, and running regression evaluations on LLM pipelines using LangSmith, LangFuse, RAGAS, or DeepEval (golden datasets, LLM-as-a-judge, hallucination checks), paired with LLM security practices (prompt injection defense, PII masking, guardrails, structured output validation, tenant isolation, and OWASP Top 10 for LLMs).
* Databases, Cloud Infrastructure: Solid experience with relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis), containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), CI/CD automation, secrets management, and deploying on major cloud platforms (AWS).

**Job Description**

As an AI Software Engineer, your primary responsibility will be to design, orchestrate, and optimise AI-assisted software delivery workflows. Rather than focusing on manual software development, you will engineer systems where AI agents contribute directly to implementation, testing, optimisation, and operational activities under human supervision and governance.

  

You will work within a small, high-performing AI Engineering Pod alongside AI Product Owners and Quality Engineers to rapidly deliver business outcomes through AI-native engineering practices.

  

The role combines software engineering, AI orchestration, automation, and lightweight platform engineering to enable faster, more adaptive, and increasingly automated delivery approaches.

  

You will leverage Generative AI tools, orchestration frameworks, and modern cloud platforms to accelerate delivery while maintaining engineering quality, security, and operational reliability. The pod operates with rapid iteration cycles, lightweight governance, and a strong focus on measurable business outcomes over traditional delivery artifacts.

**Detailed Responsibilities**

AI-Orchestrated Engineering

* Design and orchestrate AI-assisted workflows for software implementation, testing, deployment, and operational automation.
* Leverage Generative AI tooling to accelerate engineering delivery, infrastructure automation, and operational activities.
* Build lightweight services, APIs, orchestration layers, and integrations that support AI-native delivery workflows.
* Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic retrieval, and contextual AI capabilities where appropriate.
* Continuously refine prompts, orchestration patterns, and workflow performance to improve reliability, quality, and delivery efficiency.
* Troubleshoot and optimise AI workflows when outputs become inconsistent, unreliable, or operationally ineffective.

AI-Native Delivery & Automation

* Build and optimise AI-assisted CI/CD pipelines, deployment workflows, and automated engineering processes.

* Drive automation-first engineering practices across development, deployment, and operational workflows.
* Leverage AI tooling to accelerate infrastructure-as-code, configuration generation, and operational scripting.
* Deliver containerised and deployable solutions aligned with enterprise cloud and operational standards.
* Ensure observability, traceability, and logging are embedded across AI workflows and services.

Engineering Standards & Governance

* Ensure solutions align with enterprise security, architecture, and compliance standards.
* Establish reusable orchestration patterns, engineering standards, and implementation approaches for AI-assisted delivery.
* Design modular, maintainable, and composable solutions that minimise unnecessary complexity.
* Support secure AI engineering practices, including prompt safety, data handling, and output validation.
* Ensure delivered solutions are operationally supportable with appropriate documentation and monitoring.

Collaboration & Delivery

* Collaborate closely with the AI Product Owner to translate business intent into executable AI-assisted workflows.
* Work alongside the AI Quality & Evaluation Engineer to improve testing strategies, evaluation frameworks, and operational confidence.
* Engage with cloud, platform, architecture, security, and operational teams where required to support delivery outcomes.
* Participate in rapid iteration cycles focused on experimentation, validation, and measurable business outcomes.
* Share learnings, reusable patterns, and best practices across the wider engineering organization.
* Contribute to the ongoing evolution of the AI Engineering Pod operating model.

Operational Performance & Risk Management

* Monitor workflow performance, operational reliability, cost, and delivery effectiveness.
* Identify and mitigate risks relating to scalability, security, reliability, and operational sustainability.
* Support vulnerability remediation, operational improvements, and secure delivery practices.
* Continuously identify opportunities to increase automation and reduce manual engineering effort.

You are a strong software engineer who is comfortable working in environments where AI systems form part of the delivery process. You understand how to combine

engineering judgement with AI tools to design, build, and operate reliable software systems.

You are motivated by solving complex technical problems through automation, orchestration, and iterative system design, rather than manual implementation alone.

You are able to:

* Understand the strengths and limitations of AI-generated outputs and guide them toward reliable, production-ready outcomes
* Work effectively in fast-moving, experimental environments where solutions evolve through iteration rather than upfront specification
* Balance speed of delivery with engineering quality, security, and operational reliability
* Operate with a high degree of autonomy while collaborating closely with product, architecture, quality, testing, and operations colleagues
* Continuously learn and adapt as AI tooling and engineering practices evolve

**Skills & Experience**

Essential:

* Strong software engineering experience across modern application development stacks such as .NET, Node.js, Python, JavaScript, React, or similar technologies.
* Experience designing and building APIs, integrations, distributed systems, and cloud-native applications.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.

description:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.

**Job Description**

Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon.

Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place.

The Emergency Preparedness & Response (EP&R) team builds the systems that keep critical operations running when it matters most. When storms and severe weather threaten communities and infrastructure across the US, our platform enables customers to rapidly procure, mobilize, and manage the workforce needed to respond to and recover from storm damage — often under tight timelines and high-stakes conditions. We are looking for a Principal Engineer who is deeply hands-on, works backward from customer pain points and business needs, and measures success by impact rather than lines of code shipped. You will be the technical anchor of the team: a backend-heavy full-stack engineer who knows our systems inside and out, reasons rigorously about trade-offs, and raises the engineering bar for everyone around you while leading the team toward outcomes that genuinely matter.

**About the role**
------------------

We're hiring a Software Engineer in Bengaluru to build and run production services. You'll own features end to end — from understanding the problem to shipping, monitoring and fixing what you built — with growing independence and support from senior engineers.

Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. You'll work closely with senior engineers, your Engineering Manager, Product and Customer Support.

**What you'll own in your first year**
--------------------------------------

* **Own:** Own features and services end to end with speed and quality — build, test, release, monitor, fix.
* **Well-scoped problems, then bigger ones.** Start with clearly defined work and grow into breaking down ambiguous problems yourself.
* **Design.** Write design notes for your features and get them reviewed; contribute to larger designs led by senior engineers.
* **Quality.** Write tests, add observability, and take part in on-call so issues are caught before customers see them.
* **Customers.** Understand who uses what you build, and learn from support issues what to fix next.
* **Code reviews.** Give and receive thoughtful reviews, and help onboard engineers who join after you.

**What you must bring**
-----------------------

These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job.

* **Experience:** 1–4 years building production software. We level on demonstrated scope, not years alone.
* **You've shipped code that runs in production.** Features or services you built, released and supported — not only coursework or prototypes.
* **You are strong at problem solving.** You can take an unfamiliar, feature-sized problem, reason through it, and land on a simple, correct solution.
* **You work independently toward a clear goal.** Given a clear goal, you figure out the steps, unblock yourself, and ask for help at the right moments.

We care how you engineer more than which language you did it in.

**Technical background**
------------------------

You've built production software with a modern stack, such as:

* **Cloud:** hands-on with AWS — you've deployed and debugged services running on it.
* **Languages:** strong in at least one modern language such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* **Frameworks:** modern service frameworks such as FastAPI, Node.js or equivalents.
* **Databases:** solid data modeling and query fundamentals — you can design a schema, use indexes well, and explain why a query is slow and how you'd fix it.
* **Fundamentals:** data structures, API design, and the basics of caching and concurrency.

Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome.

**What sets great candidates apart**
------------------------------------

* **Impact you can explain.** You can say what changed because of something you built — for users, performance or reliability.
* **One problem you went deep on.** A bug, a performance issue or a design where you dug past the surface to understand why.
* **Ownership beyond the ticket.** You've fixed what you shipped when it broke, and improved it after release without being asked.
* **Framework mindset:** You notice repeated code and turn it into something reusable.
* **Learning speed.** You've picked up a new domain, codebase or technology quickly and delivered in it.
* **Curiosity about the user.** You've asked why a requirement exists, or suggested a simpler way to solve the user's problem.

**What we look for in everyone we hire**
----------------------------------------

Whatever the role, we hire for six things.

* **Customer obsession.** You care who uses what you build and whether it actually helped them.
* **Impact over activity.** You measure success by outcomes, not tickets closed or lines written.
* **Honesty.** You're specific about your own part in team work, raise problems early, and say what didn't work.
* **Independence.** You don't wait to be told every next step. You figure things out with little hand-holding. You will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey.
* **Passion.** Not the word on a resume — the evidence: a side project, a technology you went deep on, something you built because you wanted to.
* **Depth.** At least one thing you've built or debugged that you can explain down to the internals and the tradeoffs.

Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for!  
  
The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience.  
  
Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com.

Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www.itron.com

Data License is Bloomberg's enterprise data delivery platform, powering financial institutions worldwide with reference, pricing, regulatory, and alternative data — covering over 50 million securities across portfolio accounting, risk, compliance, and trading use cases.

The **DL Analytics Platform** is the intelligence and reliability layer of this ecosystem. We build the data ingestion pipelines, embeddings infrastructure, AI agents, and MCP tool servers that give engineers and LLMs structured, query able access to operational data. Our systems power incident triage, semantic search over tickets and documentation, pipeline health analytics, and self-service data onboarding for partner teams across Data License.

You'll join a team at the intersection of data infrastructure, reliability engineering, and applied AI — building systems that make Bloomberg's data delivery more reliable, intelligent, and scalable.

**Reliability Engineering:** GenAI-powered tooling for incident triage, root-cause analysis, and blast radius assessment — exposing live pipeline data to LLM agents via MCP tool servers.

**Data Analytics & AI:** Ingestion pipelines into Apache Iceberg, semantic search over operational data using vector databases and embedding models, and automated KPI tracking to surface platform health and anomalies.

  
  

**We'll trust you to:**

* Build GenAI tools and AI agents — RAG pipelines, contextual embedding systems, and MCP tool servers that give LLM agents structured access to live pipeline data

* Design microservices and backend APIs — with opportunities to contribute to React/TypeScript interfaces embedded in production tools

**Technologies**

* **Data & Orchestration:** Apache Iceberg, Apache Airflow, PyArrow, PyIceberg, Spark, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Parquet

* **Infrastructure:** Docker, Kubernetes, NGINX, OpenTelemetry
* **Cloud:** GCP, AWS (S3, Redshift), Snowflake, Databricks

* 6+ Software engineering experience in production environments
* Proficiency in Python or a similar language
* Familiarity with relational databases and SQL
* Interest or experience in data engineering — pipelines, batch processing, or data lake technologies

* Experience with Apache Iceberg, PyArrow, or data lake engineering

* Experience with vector databases, embedding models, or semantic search

* Collaborate with engineers across Dublin, London, and New York

title: Sr Software Engineer - Membership
description:
**About the role and team**  
  
Uber One is Uber's membership program and one of the company's biggest growth engines. One subscription gives members savings and perks on rides, food delivery, groceries and more, plus partner benefits, and it's available in markets around the world. Uber One recently passed **50 million members**, and those members now drive **about half of Uber's Gross Bookings** across Mobility and Delivery. Members spend more, come back more often and use more of Uber's services than non-members, which is why membership sits at the center of Uber's platform strategy.  
  
Behind every member's experience are systems that decide which benefits they get, what they pay, how their membership renews, and what they see in the app. All of it has to be correct in every market, currency and product, for tens of millions of people, every day.  
  
As a Senior Software Engineer on the **Catalyst** team in Membership, you'll build the platform behind how Uber One is configured, launched and evolved. Catalyst's systems let product, operations and engineering teams create and safely roll out new benefits, offers and member experiences in any market, without writing code for each launch. You'll work on high-traffic, low-latency services where correctness matters directly to members and to the business. You'll also own your work end to end, from the first design doc to production support.  
  
**What you'll do**  

* Design, build and operate highly available backend services that serve Uber One membership and benefit data at global scale.
  
* Build platform capabilities that let teams launch and change membership offers safely and quickly, including validation, approvals and gradual rollouts.
  
* Turn ambiguous product and operational requirements into clear technical designs and deliver them with engineers across Membership.
  
* Raise the team's engineering quality through design reviews, code reviews, testing, observability and on-call ownership.
  
* Mentor engineers and help shape the team's technical direction and roadmap.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* 6+ years of professional experience in backend software engineering.
  
* Proficiency in Java or Go, with experience building and operating production services.
  
* Experience designing data models and working with relational or NoSQL databases (e.g. MySQL, PostgreSQL, Cassandra).
  
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Experience building high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems serving millions of users.
  
* Experience building configuration, rules or experimentation platforms, or internal tools used by non-engineering teams.
  
* Experience with subscriptions, payments, pricing or promotions systems where correctness is critical.
  
* Experience with caching, event streaming (e.g. Kafka) and safe deployment practices such as feature flags and staged rollouts.
  
* Experience leading multi-quarter projects across teams, from design through launch and operations.

  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. You will build the foundational software layer that enables our platform to interact dynamically with massive streaming datasets. Using a mix of Golang and Python, you will orchestrate real-time data streams through Kafka and Apache Spark, and design highly resilient distributed data layers utilizing Apache Cassandra alongside PostgreSQL. * Containerization & Orchestration: Production-level experience with Docker and multi-cluster orchestration via Kubernetes / AWS EKS.

  

Qualifications

title: Software Engineer II - Frontend (Security Team)
description:
**L4 - Security Center Frontend Engineer**  
  
As an L4 UI Engineer on the Security Center frontend team, you will design, build, and own end-to-end user-facing interfaces that safeguard Uber’s global resources across multi-cloud and SaaS infrastructure. Working closely with product managers, designers, and backend teams, you will architect and ship clean, accessible, high-performance frontend features of moderate complexity with multiple cross-system dependencies for Uber’s internal Security Portal—the primary surface where users manage authentication, authorization, birthright governance, and privileged access. Driven by deep customer obsession, you will translate ambiguous security workflows into intuitive self-service experiences, establish frontend reliability and observability standards, and reduce technical debt across foundational security tools that keep Uber secure by default.  
  
**What the Candidate Will Do**  

* **End-to-End Feature Delivery & Architecture:** Own the design and delivery of frontend features of moderate complexity—from initial technical design (ERDs, design notes) to production launch with minimal oversight—navigating dependencies across Identity, Access, Risk, Secrets and application security.
  
* **Upstream Stakeholder & UX Translation:** Partner directly with TPMs, security engineers, partner teams and other stakeholders to translate customer pain points and complex security requirements into cohesive, intuitive user journeys and UI system designs.
  
* **Frontend Design & Trade-offs:** Apply modern UI design patterns and sound engineering judgment to evaluate architectural trade-offs (e.g., client-side state complexity, bundle performance, delivery velocity) and leverage or extend existing internal design systems rather than reinventing components.
  
* **Code Quality & Tech Debt Reduction:** Produce reliable, readable, well-tested TypeScript/React code; provide thorough code and design reviews to peers; and proactively identify and reduce code-level technical debt (e.g., component duplication, low test coverage, legacy patterns).
  
* **Observability, Performance & Independent On-Call:** Proactively optimize client-side performance and reliability, establish frontend monitoring and alerting standards, and participate in on-call rotations—independently troubleshooting production incidents and handling stakeholder inquiries.
  
* **Documentation, Mentorship & Team Growth:** Author feature-level technical documentation, operational runbooks, and user guides; onboard and mentor junior engineers; represent the team in internal engagements; and actively participate in technical interviewing.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* **Education:** BS or MS degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
* **Experience:** 3+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong focus on Front-End / UI architecture and application development (scaled up from 1–3 years at L3).
  
* **Core Tech Stack:** Deep proficiency in React, TypeScript, modern JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3/Sass.
  
* **UI Architecture & State Management:** Proven experience designing complex client-side state management (e.g., Redux, React Query/Context), integrating REST/GraphQL APIs, and making performance/accessibility trade-offs across large web applications.
  
* **Testing & Production Quality:** Strong track record writing comprehensive unit, integration, and end-to-end tests (e.g., Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress/Playwright) alongside production telemetry, logging, and alerting.
  
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Demonstrated ability to drive features across cross-functional stakeholders, write clear technical design docs (ERDs), and mentor peers.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Experience building enterprise security, Identity & Access Management (IAM), Governance/Compliance (RBAC, OAuth/OIDC, PAM, SaaS posture), or complex policy-configuration UIs.
  
* Experience contributing to or evolving shared UI component libraries, design systems, and frontend build/CI tooling (Vite, Webpack).
  
* Experience defining frontend reliability standards, client-side observability, or AI-assisted developer/user workflows.

  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

title: Software Engineer II – Asset Management
description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**OVERVIEW**

The Sitecore Content Hub Developer will be part of a product team responsible for designing, developing, configuring, integrating, and supporting enterprise digital asset and content management capabilities on Sitecore Content Hub.The role will work closely with product owners, business analysts, solution architects, platform engineers, and other technology teams to translate business requirements into scalable Sitecore Content Hub solutions. The individual will provide technical leadership to developers, guide implementation decisions, participate in design and code reviews, and support the platform through delivery and production operations. The role requires strong experience with Sitecore Content Hub, digital asset management concepts, content models, workflows, metadata, integrations, and software engineering practices. The person will also contribute to platform modernization, automation, performance improvements, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**  
**Project Participation**

* Participate in the complete software development lifecycle, from requirements and solution design through deployment and support.
* Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into Sitecore Content Hub solutions.
* Configure and develop Content Hub entities, schemas, taxonomies, metadata models, policies, workflows, actions, and user roles.
* Design and implement integrations between Sitecore Content Hub and enterprise systems using REST APIs, webhooks, middleware, and event-driven patterns.
* Develop and maintain custom extensions, scripts, automations, and platform configurations where appropriate.
* Contribute to technical design documents, architecture discussions, sprint planning, and task-level estimation.
* Perform technical design reviews and ensure solutions align with enterprise standards and security requirements.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure maintainable, reusable, and standards-compliant code.
* Lead or contribute to deployment, release, environment promotion, and configuration management activities.
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable fixes.
* Monitor and improve application and integration performance, reliability, and scalability.
* Collaborate with other teams to identify dependencies, manage risks, and resolve technical issues.
* Manage multiple workstreams while maintaining quality and delivery commitments.
* Provide application support on a rotation basis, including on-call support where required.

**Learning and Development**

* Stay current with Sitecore Content Hub capabilities, product releases, DAM practices, integration patterns, and relevant industry trends.
* Mentor and coach team members to build technical depth and platform expertise.
* Drive process improvements at the project and team level.
* Lead knowledge-sharing sessions, reading groups, demonstrations, and technical communities of practice.
* Participate in hiring, onboarding, and capability development activities.
* Continue to strengthen communication, collaboration, consulting, and leadership skills.

**Consulting**

* Provide module and project effort estimates.
* Recommend technical solutions and explain trade-offs to stakeholders.
* Act as a Sitecore Content Hub technical subject-matter expert.
* Develop functional expertise in digital asset management, content operations, product information, or a related business domain.
* Serve as a liaison between business analysts, product owners, architects, and developers.
Answer implementation questions and provide technical direction throughout delivery.  

  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Full-Time Bachelors degree with minimum 7-10 years of total work experience.
* Demonstrated ability to build a work plan or contribute to a work plan appropriate to the role.
* Experience implementing small projects or contributing to medium- or large-scale enterprise technology projects.
* Hands-on experience with Sitecore Content Hub, preferably including Content Management, Digital Asset Management, Product Content Management, or related modules.
* Experience configuring Content Hub data models, schemas, taxonomies, relations, metadata, workflows, roles, permissions, and business rules.
* Experience with Sitecore Content Hub APIs, REST services, webhooks, integrations, and authentication mechanisms.
* Experience developing or configuring integrations with enterprise applications, cloud services, middleware, or data platforms.
* Strong understanding of DAM concepts, including asset lifecycle management, renditions, versioning, metadata governance, rights management, and content distribution.
* Proficiency in object-oriented programming and at least one modern programming language such as C#, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
* Working knowledge of .NET, ASP.NET Core, Web API, SQL, JSON, XML, and HTTP-based services.
* Experience with source control, CI/CD, automated testing, deployment practices, and Agile delivery.
* Good working knowledge of the enterprise application and technical tools landscape.
* Ability to proactively resolve issues, take ownership, and work across multiple tasks and teams.
* Ability to become a go-to resource for the team or business group.
* Experience with third-party integrations and enterprise system interfaces.
* Provide senior-level technical leadership by shaping designs, reviewing code, strengthening engineering standards, collaborating across product and technology teams, and advising business partners.
* Design, develop, and support scalable Sitecore Content Hub capabilities for the reliable management and organization of digital assets and product content.
* Configure and extend Content Hub data models, schemas, taxonomies, relationships, metadata, workflows, roles, permissions, and business rules to support effective content governance.
* Design and maintain integrations between Content Hub and enterprise applications, cloud services, middleware, data platforms, and third-party systems, using Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, messaging/event-driven services, or equivalent technologies.
* Develop solutions using object-oriented programming and modern practices with technologies such as C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Web API, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL, JSON, and XML.
* Apply DAM expertise across the asset lifecycle, including renditions, versioning, rights management, content quality, and distribution.
* Build secure, maintainable services using Content Hub APIs, REST, webhooks, authentication mechanisms, and other HTTP-based interfaces.
* Establish and execute quality-engineering practices, including unit, integration, automated, performance, and regression testing, supported by effective CI/CD and deployment processes.
Deliver initiatives across the full software-development lifecycle, contribute to medium- and large-scale enterprise projects, and resolve production issues through root-cause analysis and durable fixes.  

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Sitecore Content Hub certification or formal Sitecore training.
* Experience with Sitecore XM Cloud, Sitecore Experience Platform, or other Sitecore products.
* Experience with Sitecore Content Hub One, Content Operations, or DAM platform migration.
* Experience with product information management, product data, or master data concepts.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure or GCP.
* Experience with Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, messaging platforms, or equivalent integration services.
* Experience with DevOps tooling, infrastructure automation, observability, and application monitoring.
* Familiarity with accessibility, security, privacy, and enterprise content governance standards.
* Experience with performance testing, unit testing, automated integration testing, and quality engineering.
* Experience working with global, distributed, and cross-functional teams.

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.
